project.name: Primitive
release_notes: Add the instagram package: typed Meta Graph media reads over Exchange with documented paging and error members.

Add the timematch package: Google, Microsoft (personal and work/school) and Apple iCloud calendar connection over Exchange, with calendar-only consent, visitor versus business grants, free/busy where any unanswered calendar is unknown, and deterministic owned event writes verified by readback.
Add Exchange's browser JSON executor (same-origin, no redirects or caching) and the TimeMatch browser client that performs HTTP only through it.
Admit WebDAV PROPFIND and REPORT as safe Exchange methods; register webmcp in the Core catalog.
